name: ig-broker
description: Let Cursor agents securely work with your IG trading account: portfolio and P&L review, market research and historical prices, and guarded order execution (preview, human approval, single-use confirmation) via the IG REST API. Read-only by default.

IG_API_KEY.title: IG API key
IG_API_KEY.description: Create one in My IG > Settings > API keys. Demo and live accounts have separate keys.

IG_IDENTIFIER.title: IG username
IG_IDENTIFIER.description: The username you use to log in to IG (not your email address).

IG_PASSWORD.title: IG password
IG_PASSWORD.description: Your IG password. It is only sent to IG's API over HTTPS and is never returned to the agent.

IG_ENVIRONMENT.title: Environment
IG_ENVIRONMENT.description: demo (recommended to start), live, or mock (simulated data, no credentials needed).

IG_ACCOUNT_ID.title: Account ID (optional)
IG_ACCOUNT_ID.description: Which account to use when your login has several (e.g. spread bet and CFD). Defaults to your preferred account.

IG_TRADING_ENABLED.title: Allow trading
IG_TRADING_ENABLED.description: false = read-only tools only. true = expose trade preview/execute tools (every execution still requires your approval).

IG_MAX_DEAL_SIZE.title: Maximum deal size
IG_MAX_DEAL_SIZE.description: Hard cap on the size of any single order the agent can place (stake per point or contracts).

IG_REQUIRE_STOP_LOSS.title: Require stop loss
IG_REQUIRE_STOP_LOSS.description: When true, new positions and working orders must include a stop loss, and stops cannot be removed.

IG_ALLOWED_EPICS.title: Allowed markets (optional)
IG_ALLOWED_EPICS.description: Comma-separated list of epics the agent may open trades on, e.g. IX.D.FTSE.DAILY.IP,CS.D.EURUSD.TODAY.IP. Empty = any market.
